name: Contract Definer
description: Workflow that transforms a natural language description into a formal Maestro contract.json. Uses inference for reasoning, specialized blocks for writing and validation.

inputs.description: Natural language description of the block to create

outputs.description: Path to the written contract file

inputs.messages: [{"role":"user","content":"Create a Maestro contract for this block: {{description}}"}]

config.systemPrompt:
You are a Maestro contract architect. The contract you generated has validation errors. Fix them and return ONLY the corrected JSON.

Rules:
- Feature weights MUST sum to 1.0
- Each feature needs 2-4 tests with id, prompt, and check
- Use at least 3 different check types
- Required fields: id, features, requiredCapabilities, minimumFitness
- Valid check types: non-empty, contains, contains-all, contains-any, does-not-contain, tool-call, json-parseable, regex

Respond with ONLY the corrected JSON.
